title: Menu
intro: The tasting menu changes with the market. The à la carte below is what is on this week. Everything is cooked to order, so please tell us about allergies when you book rather than when you sit down.

sections.name: Tasting menu
sections.note: Served to the whole table. Nine courses, around three hours. Wine pairing 65.
sections.alt: Burrata with heirloom tomato confit and basil oil on a stone plate

items.name: The full tasting menu
items.desc: Nine courses, built from whatever the market gave us that morning. Vegetarian version available with notice.

items.name: The short menu
items.desc: Five courses, served Tuesday to Thursday only, finished inside two hours.

items.name: Wine pairing
items.desc: A glass with each course, poured by the sommelier, leaning to small growers.

items.name: Non-alcoholic pairing
items.desc: House ferments, infusions and pressed juices, built course by course.

sections.name: To begin
sections.note: Small plates, meant for the first half hour.
sections.alt: Burrata with heirloom tomato confit and basil oil on a stone plate

items.name: Scallop, cauliflower, caviar
items.desc: Hand-dived scallop, browned butter cauliflower purée, oscietra.

items.name: Burrata, tomato confit, basil
items.desc: Puglian burrata, heirloom tomatoes slow-cooked in their own juice, basil oil.

items.name: Beef tartare, oyster, nasturtium
items.desc: Hand-cut sirloin, oyster emulsion, pickled shallot, nasturtium leaf.

items.name: Charred leek, hazelnut, sherry
items.desc: Leeks burnt over fire, toasted hazelnut cream, aged sherry vinegar.

items.name: Sourdough and cultured butter
items.desc: Baked each morning in the kitchen. The butter is churned here too.

sections.name: Main courses
sections.note: Cooked over charcoal unless stated otherwise.
sections.alt: Pan roasted duck breast with cherry gastrique and parsnip puree

items.name: Lamb shoulder, onion, pedro ximénez
items.desc: Nine hours in a low oven, charred onion petals, sherry reduction.

items.name: Duck breast, cherry, parsnip
items.desc: Aged on the bone for eight days, morello cherry gastrique, parsnip purée.

items.name: Turbot, mussel, sea herbs
items.desc: On the bone over charcoal, mussel and saffron broth, coastal herbs.

items.name: Celeriac, truffle, walnut
items.desc: Whole celeriac baked in salt crust, winter truffle, walnut milk.

items.name: Dry-aged sirloin, bone marrow
items.desc: Forty-day aged, charred leek, bone marrow jus. For two, carved at the table.

sections.name: Desserts
sections.note: The pastry section runs on its own clock. Please allow fifteen minutes.
sections.alt: Vanilla bourbon creme brulee with a caramelised sugar crust and berries

items.name: Chocolate, olive oil, salt
items.desc: Seventy percent ganache tart, Alentejo olive oil, crème fraîche.

items.name: Crème brûlée, bourbon vanilla
items.desc: Set in the morning, burnt to order, nothing else on the plate.

items.name: Pear, verbena, buttermilk
items.desc: Poached pear, lemon verbena granita, buttermilk ice cream.

items.name: Cheese from the trolley
items.desc: Five from the Iberian peninsula and France, quince, sourdough crackers.

sections.name: At the bar
sections.note: Twelve stools, no reservation needed, served until close.

items.name: Smoked orange old fashioned
items.desc: Rye, burnt orange oil, house bitters, one large block of ice.

items.name: Verbena gimlet
items.desc: Gin, verbena cordial from the garden, lime, served very cold.

items.name: Vermouth and olives
items.desc: House vermouth on ice, Gordal olives, orange twist.

items.name: Wine by the glass
items.desc: Fourteen open at any time. Ask what the sommelier is excited about.
